subject.title: improve: let Code Mode use declared tool result shapes

question: Should `outputSchema` become the supported optional Plugin SDK contract for describing and validating `AgentToolResult.details` across Code Mode and Tool Search?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but adding a public plugin API and its permanent validation semantics requires explicit owner intent rather than automated acceptance.

options.title: Approve the shared contract
options.body: Accept the optional field and its fail-closed trusted-schema semantics after exact-head required checks complete.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Limit declared output metadata to core-owned tools until the external Plugin SDK contract and compatibility policy are separately designed.

options.title: Pause output contracts
options.body: Retain unknown raw-first outputs and defer both model-visible hints and runtime validation until the API direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared contract
recommendation.body: Accept the optional field and its fail-closed trusted-schema semantics after exact-head required checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The Code Mode performance series and this proposed API are concentrated in their recent merged and current work, making them the strongest available routing candidate.
